question: In which of the following states was the Santosh Trophy 2021-22 held in the month of April-May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kerala won the Santosh Trophy 2021-22, marking the 75th edition of the tournament.
 
• The Santosh Trophy is a prestigious football tournament in India, organized by the All India Football Federation (AIFF).
 
• The final match saw Kerala triumph over West Bengal, securing their victory.
 
• This win adds to Kerala's illustrious history in the tournament, showcasing their strong football culture and talent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Santosh Trophy was started in 1941 and is named after the late Maharaja Sir Manmatha Nath Roy Chowdhary of Santosh.
 
• The tournament is an annual competition in Indian football and is contested by states and government institutions.
 
• West Bengal has historically been one of the most successful teams in the Santosh Trophy, with numerous titles to their name.
 
• The competition provides a platform for players from different states to showcase their talent and potentially get selected for the national team.
